title: Fixed Long Shaft and Windowed Bell Hand Blender
description: One newly authored complete fixed long-shaft handheld-blender-style exterior. A long contoured axial grip housing with upper cap, short lower collar and blank thumb control joins a complete narrow shaft housing. At the lower end one thick flared bell has a genuinely open bottom, four actual finite side windows and an occupied upper shaft bore. Inside it a separate fixed spindle, small hub and four finite blunt paddle plates remain attached; the guard partially hides them in ordinary views. This complete single-axis grip-shaft-windowed-shroud form is not the old horizontal twin-wire-cage mixer with a cage removed or the old jug motor base resized. Three opaque materials, one prop zero scenes. Bell rim ground contact is a display datum only, not a self-standing or operating claim. No food, liquids, sharp edge, powered rotation, heating, motor internals, mixing procedure, fit, hygiene, ergonomic or electrical safety performance. Rigging animation interaction not made.
